Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing the department of fish and wildlife to accept commercial license or permit applications after the application deadline.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a mechanism by which the department offish and wildlife can accept applications submitted after theapplication deadline; and amending RCW 77.65.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.65.030 and 2003 c 386 s 5 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The application deadline for a commercial license or permitestablished in this chapter is December 31st of the calendar year forwhich the license or permit is sought. ((The department shall acceptno license or permit applications after December 31st of the calendaryear for which the license or permit is sought.)) (2) Any application received after the application deadline must beassessed a late fee that is to be collected in addition to theprescribed fees for the license or permit. Late fees under thissection must be assessed according to the following schedule: (a) One hundred twentyfive dollars for an application received oneto thirty days after the application deadline; (b) Two hundred fifty dollars for an application received thirtyone to sixty days after the application deadline; and p. 1 HB 1995 (c) Five hundred dollars for an application received sixty-one ormore days after the application deadline. (3) Except as otherwise provided in this section, the departmentmay not waive late fee assessments. (4)(a) Except for license or permit renewal applications receivedby the department during the 2008 calendar year and except as otherwiseprovided in this subsection, the department may not renew a license orpermit under this chapter if the application is received later than oneyear after the application deadline established in this section. (b) An applicant who is denied renewal of a permit or license underthis chapter for submitting an application after the applicationdeadline may submit a written request for an administrative hearing tothe department within thirty days of the date of the department'sdenial. The department, upon consideration of the appeal, may grantrenewal. If the department grants renewal, it shall assess theapplicable late fee pursuant to this section. (5) The application deadline and late fees in this section ((does))do not apply to a license or permit that has not been renewed becauseof the death or incapacity of the license or permit holder. Thelicense or permit holder's surviving spouse, estate, estatebeneficiary, attorneyinfact, or guardian must be given an additionalone hundred eighty days to renew the license or permit. If renewedwithin one hundred eighty days, the late fees provided in this sectiondo not apply. (6) All late fees collected by the department under this sectionmust be distributed in the manner prescribed for the license or permitfees associated with the underlying license.
